name: Tracking Alpha

name: Stock Opinion Extractor
summary: Apify Actor that reads posts you supply (an X archive or a pasted list) and returns the tickers each post names, a rule-based bullish, bearish or unclear stance with the evidence sentence, and a per-ticker summary across authors. Paid per row on Apify; no scraping and no model.
